reason: The original V0.2 forward was operationally nonfunctional for two independent reasons: GitHub scheduled workflows only run canonically from the default branch, while this workflow lived only on the feature branch; and Binance Vision daily USD-M 5m archives for D-1 were empirically observed publishing around 08:14-08:35 UTC on 2026-09-21/22, far after the frozen 00:25 UTC schedule.

scientific_contract.realized_variance: sum squared 5m close-to-close log returns on UTC day; accepted day >=270 returns
scientific_contract.challenger: same HAR plus target-day Tue-Sun dummies, Monday base

source_transport_remediation.selected_source: Binance Vision USD-M futures 5m archives — unchanged from parent source family
source_transport_remediation.rejected_transport: Binance USD-M REST from GitHub-hosted runner
source_transport_remediation.rejected_reason: primary fapi endpoint returned HTTP 451; fapi1-fapi4 returned unusable non-JSON responses in controlled probe
source_transport_remediation.scientific_effect: NONE — source semantics remain USD-M futures 5m; only arming time is moved after observed archive publication.

trigger_remediation.new_trigger: daily external trigger updates the existing open diagnostic PR branch; PR synchronize invokes the branch-local forward workflow

forward_interpretation.label: PROSPECTIVE_BLIND_DELAYED_SOURCE
forward_interpretation.scientific_use: Valid forward forecast evidence because only D-1 and earlier source data enter the frozen model.
forward_interpretation.execution_limitation: Forecast is timestamped after target UTC day has begun because the canonical archive is delayed. This does not authorize intraday execution or any trading application. A low-latency exact-source application layer would require separate prospective authority.
